candidate.claim: Context.lookup checks cache.hasOwnProperty(name). After caching a view key named 'hasOwnProperty', the method is shadowed by a string value, so any later lookup on the same Context throws TypeError instead of returning the value.
candidate.title: Context cache lookup shadows hasOwnProperty method

verifier.reason: The cache is created as a plain object literal at mustache.js:377, and lookup invokes it as cache.hasOwnProperty(name) at mustache.js:397, so once a string view value is cached under 'hasOwnProperty' it shadows Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty and any subsequent lookup on that Context attempts to call a string and throws TypeError.

candidate.claim: Parse cache key concatenates template and tags with ':' separator, so distinct template/tags pairs (e.g. template 'foo' with tags ['bar:baz','qux'] vs template 'foo:bar' with tags ['baz','qux']) produce the same key and return wrong cached tokens.
candidate.title: Ambiguous template cache key collides

verifier.reason: The key at mustache.js:512 is built as template + ':' + (tags || mustache.tags).join(':') with no escaping or length prefix, so 'foo' with ['bar:baz','qux'] and 'foo:bar' with ['baz','qux'] both produce 'foo:bar:baz:qux', and mustache.js:514-518 returns the cached tokens on a hit without re-parsing.
